read.description: Reading datapoints and cameras. The roles that hold this kind of access by default; an empty list means nobody does, however senior the role.

invoke.description: Calling services and starting actions. The roles that hold this kind of access by default; an empty list means nobody does, however senior the role.

publish.description: Driving a robot through its publishers. The roles that hold this kind of access by default; an empty list means nobody does, however senior the role.

assets.description: A robot's asset files, such as its URDF and meshes. The roles that hold this kind of access by default; an empty list means nobody does, however senior the role.

job_history.description: The history of a robot's jobs. The roles that hold this kind of access by default; an empty list means nobody does, however senior the role.

defaults.description: Every kind of access, each with the keys of the roles that hold it when a robot's published configuration names nobody.
